summary: Hilton Grand Vacations filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 10 to its Credit Agreement, incurring an $850 million New Term Loan due 2033. Proceeds refinance ~$849 million of existing 2028 term loans and for general corporate purposes. The new term loan is pari passu with existing facilities, bears interest at Term SOFR + 2.00% (or Base Rate + 1.00%), is guaranteed by subsidiaries, and secured by first-priority liens on substantially all assets. This is a routine liability management refinancing, not a special situation; no recommendation or risk-arb angle applies.
